title: Strict and unrestricted polynomial size
statement: For every Boolean language $L$, recognition by polynomial-size families of directed acyclic Boolean circuits with fan-in at most two is equivalent to the existence of natural numbers $a,k$ and a circuit family whose size is at most $a(n+1)^k$ for every input length $n$, whose circuit at length zero has fan-in at most two, and whose circuits at every positive input length have gates with distinct inputs and exactly one input for NOT gates and exactly two for AND and OR gates, with every vertex other than the output feeding at least one gate.
